page.heading: Conventions
page.subtitle: Scan this repository for the house rules it already follows — each one backed by a file and a line you can check.
page.scanDone: Scan finished: {count} candidate(s) from {files} sampled file(s).
page.scanFailed: The scan could not finish. Check that the repo is cloned and indexed, and that a model is configured under Settings → Feature Models.
page.loadError: Could not load the convention candidates.
page.acceptedNote: These rules go into the skill. Send one back to the candidates to decide on it later, or reject it to rule it out for good.

empty.title: No conventions extracted yet
empty.body: A scan reads this repo's linter, formatter and tsconfig files plus its most-depended-on source files, then proposes the rules they demonstrate. Nothing is applied until you accept it.

allTriaged.title: Everything has been triaged
allTriaged.body: Every candidate from the last scan was accepted or rejected. Re-scan to look for rules the first pass missed — rejected ones will not come back.

createModal.title: Create a skill from these conventions
createModal.subtitle: {count} accepted rule(s) will be written into one skill.
createModal.explainer: This assembles the rules you accepted into a single skill an agent can be instructed with. The text below is a proposal — edit it before saving, because this body becomes literal instructions in the agent's prompt. Re-running this later updates the same skill instead of creating a second one.
createModal.descriptionHint: One directive line — this is what an agent reads to decide whether the skill applies.
createModal.agentHint: The skill is appended to that agent's list, after its existing skills.
createModal.bodyHint: Every rule keeps its file and line so a reviewer can check the evidence behind it.
